classification.difficultyReason: Read horizontal and vertical extents from four supplied relations, distinguishing included endpoints, excluded axes and a constant x-value.

content.prompt: Write down the domain and range of each relation shown below.

answer.worked:
The semicircle extends horizontally from $x=-2$ to $x=0$ and vertically from $y=-2$ to $y=2$. Both endpoints are included.

Domain: $-2\le x\le0$. Range: $-2\le y\le2$.

answer.short: Domain: all real $x$. Range: all real $y$.
